proposed_comments.title: Include directories in bookmark payloads (1/2)
proposed_comments.body:
### Include directories in bookmark payloads (1/2)

**Severity:** `medium`

Directory bookmarks are classified and the shared data-package helper already creates StorageFolder items, but this predicate rejects every directory because it only accepts file kinds and File.Exists.

```suggestion
            classification.Kind is CommandKind.FileExecutable or CommandKind.FileDocument or CommandKind.Shortcut or CommandKind.InternetShortcut or CommandKind.Directory &&
            (File.Exists(classification.Target) || Directory.Exists(classification.Target))
```

### Import the ResourceMap stream reference type (1/12)

**Severity:** `medium`

The resource map stores `RandomAccessStreamReference` values, so the transfer helper needs the WinRT streams namespace before it can copy those entries.

```suggestion

using Windows.Storage.Streams;
```

proposed_comments.title: Hide the pin target for commands already persisted
proposed_comments.body:
### Hide the pin target for commands already persisted

**Severity:** `medium`

With a zero pinned-item display limit, a command that remains pinned in settings can reappear in Recent with `CanPin=true`. This exposes the pin target, but `TryPinItem` immediately rejects the same provider/command identity. Check the persisted setting before advertising an operation that cannot succeed.

```suggestion
            QuickAccessShelfPinDropTarget.Visibility = item.CanPin &&
                !_settingsService.Settings.IsCommandPinned(item.ProviderId, item.CommandId) &&
                !QuickAccessShelf.VisibleItems.Any(visibleItem => visibleItem.IsPinned)
```

confidence.rationale: Exact pinned-head control-flow tracing and an executable reproduction prove that a persisted command can be rendered in Recent with CanPin=true while TryPinItem rejects it. The minimal literal guard built independently and with all accepted suggestions.
